text:
Maria (Finance): Hey — invoice INV-2034 (Feb) shows a mismatch on dedicated reserved capacity vs billed usage. Looks like we were billed for an unexpected burst; can someone confirm if this is a metering bug or a legitimate overage?

Ajay (Acct Mgmt): Which customer and commit? need the numbers to triage.

Maria (Finance): It's ACME-CORP, reserved commit = 50,000 GPU-hours. Quick extract below: 

```
account,commit_hours,reserved_hours,burst_hours,burst_charge
acme-corp,50000,50000,12000,6200
zenhealth,120000,100000,35000,17500
```

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2034 posted to acme-corp on 2026-02-28. Charges queued for collection.

Tess (Sales): This hit ACME — they say it was a one-time large test. We should avoid surprise charges if it's our platform error.

Kevin (Billing): I pulled the meter logs. There's a cluster of duplicate start/end events around 2026-02-14 01:00-02:00 UTC for acme-corp jobs — looks like a replay from the orchestration layer. Could be double-counting of active sessions. I'll run a reconciliation script to compute deduped usage.

Ajay (Acct Mgmt): Can we hold collections until recon finishes? I'd approve provisional credit if it's our fault.

Kevin (Billing): Propose: hold invoice collections for ACME, run recon, and if diff > $1k apply one-off credit. I'll post the reconciled CSV and delta.

Tess (Sales): Please hold. I'll message the customer: short note that we're investigating and won't charge while we validate.

Maria (Finance): Action items: 1) Kevin run reconcile and post diff CSV; 2) Billing open infra ticket for orchestration replay; 3) Finance prepare refund memo if required. Deadline EOD Wed.

billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-907: "dedicated-meter-reconcile-acme-dup-count".

Kevin (Billing): Recon scheduled, expect results by 1795126000.

Maria (Finance): For approvals: Ajay, can you sign off on up to $7,000 provisional one-off credit if the recon shows duplicate billing? We want to avoid changing commit tiers for now.

Ajay (Acct Mgmt): Confirmed. Approving up to $7,000 one-off credit to resolve quickly.

Tess (Sales): Thanks team — I'll send the customer note and loop in solutions. :thumbsup:

Maria (Finance): Great — updating the invoice workflow to mark INV-2034 as "on hold - recon". Will follow up once Kevin posts the reconciled file.
